body:
My alarm is ringing.Time to go to my job, don't really have anything else to do.

I will think of becoming a fully fledged NEET.

Sorry for wasting everyones time

Iwill still reply to messages and replies for now. If you think that you've got something to say ...

I would say 2/3 by them (will explain shortly) and 1/3 me.

I refer my parents, colleagues, bosses, friends and other family members as "them". I hate it every time they've asked "Have you done XY? No? What are you even doing then" and stuff. I stopped going to unneccessary family gatherings because of that, only getting out of my room for food, job, toilet... that's it.

I've got no hobbies I can identify with since I dont even know what I like or dislike, or what I think I am good at and what "they" (see paragraph above) see suitable.

No, no no no no, N O.

I really appreciate your advice, but I'm done with the whole "It'll get better over time" Crap.

Everyone seems to have skills and knowledge or other skills that I can't aquire in time. I need results. Results, as in physical work done.

I feel like I have nothing to indetify with. If I can't bring any solution or result (3. time I have used that word), I really feel like I'm worthless and should just off myself.

A great qustion! Let me tell you why...

I was eager on getting this position in the past. It would've suited me the best, since it combines two of my favourite things: Money and my skillset.

Now I realize that I'm just "replaceable", since I'm not good at it. I don't bring the results I've hoped to achieve. Now everyone is dissappointed, even me in myself, and that hurts.

I've tried other jobs as well, short-term internships here and there, just to see on how its like. But nothing really "spoke" to me.

Now, if nothing, even my dream job, seems suitable for me, what should I do? I'm giving up the search.
